name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-13

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    - name: Install Homebrew
      run: /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

    - name: Add Homebrew paths to PATH
      run: echo "/usr/local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

    - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
      run: brew install openssl libffi

    - name: Create virtual environment
      run: python -m venv venv

    - name: Activate virtual environment
      run: source venv/bin/activate

    - name: Install required packages
      run: pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

    - name: Run pyinstaller.sh
      run: ./pyinstaller.sh

    - name: Archive artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-app-bundle
        path: dist/SSHPilot.app

    - name: Archive DMG
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-dmg
        path: dist/*.dmg

    - name: Generate checksum
      run: shasum -a 256 dist/*.dmg > dist/checksum.txt

    - name: Archive checksum
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-checksum
        path: dist/checksum.txt

yaml:
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-13

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    - name: Install Homebrew
      run: /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

    - name: Add Homebrew paths to PATH
      run: echo "/usr/local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

    - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
      run: brew install openssl libffi

    - name: Create virtual environment
      run: python -m venv venv

    - name: Activate virtual environment
      run: source venv/bin/activate

    - name: Install required packages
      run: pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

    - name: Run pyinstaller.sh
      run: ./pyinstaller.sh

    - name: Archive artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-app-bundle
        path: dist/SSHPilot.app

    - name: Archive DMG
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-dmg
        path: dist/*.dmg

    - name: Generate checksum
      run: shasum -a 256 dist/*.dmg > dist/checksum.txt

    - name: Archive checksum
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-checksum
        path: dist/checksum.txt
